about: How AzerothGPS StreetView ships its pictures: inside the viewer addon itself (the user, 2026-09-29: one addon, no separate data packs). The build writes the pictures (SD tiles scaled from build/master) and the real Index.lua into build/packs/AzerothGPS_StreetView/; `sv.cmd install` lays them over the viewer's code in the game, and `sv.cmd release` zips code and pictures together for CurseForge (the pictures never go into git, so the tag workflow only makes a code-only GitHub release). The zip stays under budget_bytes (CurseForge refuses files of 2 GB or more). 'spacing_yd' is how far apart the capture renders spots (the master keeps them all); 'ship_spacing_yd' how far apart the shipped ones are (pack.ship_points; 200 yd, the user 2026-09-29). 'planned' is the shipped spots expected, for projecting the full size. HD packs are not made or shipped for now.
about_city: City spots (the capitals' own streets, meta.json 'city') ship every ~75 yd: pack.ship_points thins them after the road spots, never displacing a shipped road spot.

viewer.name: AzerothGPS_StreetView
viewer.about_requires: AzerothGPS is a Required Dependency in the CurseForge project's Default Relations (the user, 2026-10-03), which every file gets; uploads send no relations of their own (a wrong slug would fail the upload)
